WITH checked_tenant AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM organizations.tenant WHERE id=$1 AND status='ACTIVE'), checked_member AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM memberships.membership WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status='ACTIVE'), available_units AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT u.tenant_id,u.id,u.type FROM organizations.organizational_unit u
 JOIN checked_tenant t ON t.id=u.tenant_id
 JOIN organizations.business_group g ON g.tenant_id=u.tenant_id
 JOIN organizations.organizational_unit gu ON gu.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND gu.id=g.id AND gu.status='ACTIVE'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.branch b ON b.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND b.id=u.id AND u.type='BRANCH'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.company c ON c.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND c.id=CASE WHEN u.type='COMPANY' THEN u.id ELSE b.company_id END
 LEFT JOIN organizations.organizational_unit cu ON cu.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cu.id=c.id
 WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND
 ((u.type='GROUP' AND u.id=g.id) OR (u.type IN ('COMPANY','BRANCH') AND cu.status='ACTIVE' AND c.business_group_id=g.id))), grants AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id AS role_id,p.id AS permission_id,p.code
 FROM "authorization".role r
 JOIN "authorization".role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN "authorization".permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='ACTIVE'
 WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.status='ACTIVE'),
      checked_assignments AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM "authorization".role_assignment a JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE') SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checked_assignments a
      JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id
      JOIN grants g ON g.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND g.role_id=a.role_id
      JOIN available_units u ON u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND u.id=a.scope_unit_id AND u.type=a.scope_type
      WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND g.code=$3 AND a.scope_type=$4 AND a.scope_unit_id=$5) AS allowed

 JOIN checked_tenant t ON t.id=u.tenant_id
 JOIN organizations.business_group g ON g.tenant_id=u.tenant_id
 JOIN organizations.organizational_unit gu ON gu.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND gu.id=g.id AND gu.status='ACTIVE'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.branch b ON b.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND b.id=u.id AND u.type='BRANCH'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.company c ON c.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND c.id=CASE WHEN u.type='COMPANY' THEN u.id ELSE b.company_id END
 LEFT JOIN organizations.organizational_unit cu ON cu.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cu.id=c.id
 WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND
 ((u.type='GROUP' AND u.id=g.id) OR (u.type IN ('COMPANY','BRANCH') AND cu.status='ACTIVE' AND c.business_group_id=g.id))), grants AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id AS role_id,p.id AS permission_id,p.code
 FROM "authorization".role r
 JOIN "authorization".role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN "authorization".permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='ACTIVE'
 WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.status='ACTIVE'),
      checked_assignments AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM "authorization".role_assignment a JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE') SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checked_assignments a
      JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id
      JOIN grants g ON g.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND g.role_id=a.role_id
      JOIN available_units u ON u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND u.id=a.scope_unit_id AND u.type=a.scope_type
      WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND g.code=$3 AND a.scope_type=$4 AND a.scope_unit_id=$5) AS allowed

 LEFT JOIN organizations.branch b ON b.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND b.id=u.id AND u.type='BRANCH'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.company c ON c.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND c.id=CASE WHEN u.type='COMPANY' THEN u.id ELSE b.company_id END

 ((u.type='GROUP' AND u.id=g.id) OR (u.type IN ('COMPANY','BRANCH') AND cu.status='ACTIVE' AND c.business_group_id=g.id))), grants AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id AS role_id,p.id AS permission_id,p.code

 JOIN "authorization".role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.status='ACTIVE'

WITH checked_tenant AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM organizations.tenant WHERE id=$1 AND status='ACTIVE'), checked_member AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM memberships.membership WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status='ACTIVE'), available_units AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT u.tenant_id,u.id,u.type FROM organizations.organizational_unit u
 JOIN checked_tenant t ON t.id=u.tenant_id
 JOIN organizations.business_group g ON g.tenant_id=u.tenant_id
 JOIN organizations.organizational_unit gu ON gu.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND gu.id=g.id AND gu.status='ACTIVE'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.branch b ON b.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND b.id=u.id AND u.type='BRANCH'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.company c ON c.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND c.id=CASE WHEN u.type='COMPANY' THEN u.id ELSE b.company_id END
 LEFT JOIN organizations.organizational_unit cu ON cu.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cu.id=c.id
 WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND
 ((u.type='GROUP' AND u.id=g.id) OR (u.type IN ('COMPANY','BRANCH') AND cu.status='ACTIVE' AND c.business_group_id=g.id))), grants AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id AS role_id,p.id AS permission_id,p.code
 FROM "authorization".role r
 JOIN "authorization".role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN "authorization".permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='ACTIVE'
 WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.status='ACTIVE'),
      checked_assignments AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM "authorization".role_assignment a JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE') SELECT DISTINCT a.scope_type,a.scope_unit_id FROM checked_assignments a
      JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id
      JOIN grants g ON g.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND g.role_id=a.role_id
      JOIN available_units u ON u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND u.id=a.scope_unit_id AND u.type=a.scope_type
      WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND g.code=$3

WITH checked_tenant AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT $1::uuid AS id), checked_member AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM memberships.membership WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND status='ACTIVE'), available_units AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT u.tenant_id,u.id,u.type FROM organizations.organizational_unit u
 JOIN checked_tenant t ON t.id=u.tenant_id
 JOIN organizations.business_group g ON g.tenant_id=u.tenant_id
 JOIN organizations.organizational_unit gu ON gu.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND gu.id=g.id AND gu.status='ACTIVE'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.branch b ON b.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND b.id=u.id AND u.type='BRANCH'
 LEFT JOIN organizations.company c ON c.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND c.id=CASE WHEN u.type='COMPANY' THEN u.id ELSE b.company_id END
 LEFT JOIN organizations.organizational_unit cu ON cu.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cu.id=c.id
 WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND
 ((u.type='GROUP' AND u.id=g.id) OR (u.type IN ('COMPANY','BRANCH') AND cu.status='ACTIVE' AND c.business_group_id=g.id))), grants AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id AS role_id,p.id AS permission_id,p.code
 FROM "authorization".role r
 JOIN "authorization".role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.status='ACTIVE'
 JOIN "authorization".permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='ACTIVE'
 WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.status='ACTIVE'),
      checked_assignments AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM "authorization".role_assignment a JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE') SELECT DISTINCT a.scope_type,a.scope_unit_id FROM checked_assignments a
      JOIN checked_member m ON m.id=a.membership_id
      JOIN grants g ON g.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND g.role_id=a.role_id
      JOIN available_units u ON u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND u.id=a.scope_unit_id AND u.type=a.scope_type
      WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE' AND g.code=$3

WITH current_member AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,tenant_id FROM memberships.membership WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND user_identity_id=$3 AND status='ACTIVE'),
    available_units AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT u.tenant_id,u.id,u.type FROM organizations.organizational_unit u
      JOIN organizations.tenant t ON t.id=u.tenant_id AND t.status='ACTIVE'
      JOIN organizations.business_group g ON g.tenant_id=u.tenant_id
      JOIN organizations.organizational_unit gu ON gu.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND gu.id=g.id AND gu.type='GROUP' AND gu.status='ACTIVE'
      LEFT JOIN organizations.branch b ON b.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND b.id=u.id AND u.type='BRANCH'
      LEFT JOIN organizations.company c ON c.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND c.id=CASE WHEN u.type='COMPANY' THEN u.id ELSE b.company_id END
      LEFT JOIN organizations.organizational_unit cu ON cu.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cu.id=c.id AND cu.status='ACTIVE'
      WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.status='ACTIVE' 
      AND ((u.type='GROUP' AND u.id=g.id) OR (u.type IN ('COMPANY','BRANCH') AND cu.id IS NOT NULL AND c.business_group_id=g.id))),
    assignments AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.tenant_id,a.role_id,a.scope_type,a.scope_unit_id FROM "authorization".role_assignment a JOIN current_member m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.id=a.membership_id WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.status='ACTIVE'),
    grants AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id AS role_id,p.id AS permission_id,p.code,p.status AS permission_status FROM "authorization".role r JOIN "authorization".role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.status='ACTIVE' JOIN "authorization".permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE r.tenant_id=$1 AND r.status='ACTIVE'),

      JOIN (SELECT u.tenant_id,u.id,u.type FROM organizations.organizational_unit u
      JOIN organizations.tenant t ON t.id=u.tenant_id AND t.status='ACTIVE'
      JOIN organizations.business_group g ON g.tenant_id=u.tenant_id
      JOIN organizations.organizational_unit gu ON gu.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND gu.id=g.id AND gu.type='GROUP' AND gu.status='ACTIVE'
      LEFT JOIN organizations.branch b ON b.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND b.id=u.id AND u.type='BRANCH'
      LEFT JOIN organizations.company c ON c.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND c.id=CASE WHEN u.type='COMPANY' THEN u.id ELSE b.company_id END
      LEFT JOIN organizations.organizational_unit cu ON cu.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND cu.id=c.id AND cu.status='ACTIVE'
      WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.type=$5 AND u.id=$6
      AND ((u.type='GROUP' AND u.id=g.id) OR (u.type IN ('COMPANY','BRANCH') AND cu.id IS NOT NULL AND c.business_group_id=g.id))) u ON u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND u.id=a.scope_unit_id AND u.type=a.scope_type
      WHERE a.tenant_id=$1 AND a.membership_id=$2 AND a.scope_type=$5 AND a.scope_unit_id=$6 AND a.status='ACTIVE'
